text: This cat has a wallet.
And bills to pay!
Welcome to Catchami — a living animal economy!
It starts in the real world. Find an animal, throw your CamiCube, and turn a successful catch into a playable NFT.
With its very own wallet.
Now, give your pet a life.
Explore, gather resources, and earn coins.
But every action costs energy. And every pet gets hungry.
Resources have real demand.
Prices change as pets gather, consume, and trade.
Find a travelling merchant, and turn your work into coins!
Think your pet is lucky?
Challenge another pet in Bubble Roulette!
Win resources and coins... or end up completely soaked!
Every pet has needs.
Buy food. Recover with medicine. Craft equipment. Trade what you create.
And every purchase changes the economy.
And here's the best part.
Your pet can run its own little business.
Set its strategy, and it will gather, find merchants, trade, rest, and look after itself, even when you're not controlling it.
Behind it all is a living economy.
HQ collects what players spend, funds the travelling merchants, and adjusts their budgets as the treasury and market change.
Every coin has a source. Every expense has a destination.
Real NFTs. A token balance inside every pet. Gameplay, settled on NEAR.
Catchami.
Catch a pet. Give it a life.
